about.title: Nurturing Young Minds, Inspiring Bright Futures
paragraphs: Dolphin Kids School, established in 2002, is committed to providing high-quality foundational education through a blend of international teaching methodologies, innovative learning practices and Indian values.
We believe every child is unique and deserves an environment that encourages curiosity, creativity, confidence and independent thinking.

Our educational approach integrates Montessori, experiential and inquiry-based learning with internationally recognised programmes such as Jolly Phonics & Grammar (UK), Fitzroy Readers (Australia), STEM UK and Jodo Gyan Mathematics.
Our focus extends beyond academics to holistic development through Personal, Social and Emotional Development (PSED), performing arts, music, dance, theatre, sports and creative exploration.
about.closing: At Dolphin Kids School, we aim to build strong foundations that prepare children not just for their next academic stage but for lifelong success.

about.image_caption: On campus at Dolphin Kids, Greater Noida

pillars.title: Our Mission
pillars.text: To provide high-quality foundational education that blends international teaching methodologies, innovative learning practices and Indian values, so every child builds strong foundations for the next stage and for life.

pillars.title: Our Educational Philosophy

pillars.title: Our Academic Excellence

process.title: Making every step towards learning simple, smooth and memorable.
process.lead: At Dolphin Kids School, we believe that every child is unique. Our admission process is designed to make the journey from the first enquiry to the first day of school easy, transparent and parent-friendly.
process.notice: This process applies to Nursery through Grade 2 only. Pre-Nursery is not included. For Pre-Nursery admission from 20 months, please contact our admissions team separately; the 31 March session cut-off does not apply.
process.action_note: WhatsApp opens with a prepared message; nothing is sent until you press send.
process.steps_title: Nine steps, from first hello to first day

steps.title: Admission Enquiry
steps.intro: Parents can enquire about admissions through our website, telephone, WhatsApp or by visiting the school campus.
points: Share basic details of the child.
Know about programmes, age eligibility, facilities and fee structure.

steps.title: Campus Visit & School Tour
steps.intro: Parents are invited to visit the Dolphin Kids campus to experience our learning environment.
points: Explore classrooms, activity zones and play areas.
Understand our curriculum and teaching methodology.
Learn about day care, transport and extracurricular activities.

steps.title: Admission Counselling
steps.intro: Our admission team helps parents select the most suitable programme based on the child's age, previous schooling and developmental readiness.
points: Discussion about the child's interests and learning needs.
Explanation of curriculum, programmes and facilities.
Guidance on class placement and school readiness.

steps.title: Registration & Application Form
steps.intro: Parents complete the admission registration process.
points: Fill in the admission application form.
Provide the child's and parents' basic information.

steps.title: Child Interaction & Readiness Assessment
steps.intro: An age-appropriate interaction is conducted to understand the child's developmental level.
points: Observation of communication, social interaction and confidence.

No formal entrance examination for early years.

steps.title: Document Submission
steps.intro: Parents are requested to submit the required documents, listed in full in the checklist.

Aadhaar, previous report card and Transfer Certificate wherever applicable.
PEN for students transferring from another school, wherever applicable.

steps.title: Admission Confirmation & Fee Payment
steps.intro: Once the application and documents are verified, parents receive admission confirmation.
points: Payment of admission and applicable fees.
Sharing of admission confirmation and joining details.

steps.intro: Before the child begins school, parents are guided through the school's policies and routines.
points: Introduction to teachers and school staff.
Information about school timings and uniform.

learning.title: Indian foundations. A world of discovery.
learning.lead: Indian values and foundational learning meet international early-years programmes: literacy, hands-on mathematics, science, movement and the arts, woven into one connected journey from Preschool to Grade 2.

origins.detail: Indian values and foundational learning, with hands-on mathematics through Jodo Gyan.
Jolly Phonics and Jolly Grammar for literacy; STEM UK as listed by the school.
Fitzroy Readers: a phonics-based pathway towards reading fluency and confidence.

learning.origins_note: Flags identify programme origins only, not government or provider endorsement. Indian & International Curriculum describes our blend of learning approaches, not CBSE or IB accreditation. The management-confirmed Korean learning partnership is separate from these programme origins.

items.name: International Curriculum
items.text: An internationally inspired early-years framework that brings literacy, enquiry, labs and the arts into one connected day.

items.name: Jolly Phonics
items.text: A multisensory early literacy programme using sounds, actions, stories and songs to build reading and writing foundations.

items.name: Jolly Grammar
items.text: Grammar made visible and joyful, so children learn how sentences work as they learn to write them.

items.name: Grammar Starter
items.text: Age-appropriate grammar foundations for the youngest writers and speakers.

items.name: Fitzroy Readers
items.text: A phonics-based reading series that moves children from decoding to fluent, confident reading.

items.name: Montessori Learning
items.text: Purposeful materials and practical life work that grow independence and concentration.

items.name: STEAM Education
items.text: Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts and Mathematics through building, designing and testing ideas.

items.name: Language Labs
items.text: A dedicated space for speech, listening and the confidence to speak in front of others.

items.name: Science Labs
items.text: Small scientists observe, predict and discover cause and effect.

items.name: EVS Labs
items.text: The world around us: plants, animals, water, seasons and everyday life.

items.name: Maths Labs
items.text: Numbers you can hold: counting, patterns, shapes and measuring.

items.name: KinderGym
items.text: Physical confidence through balance, coordination and joyful movement.

items.name: KinderMusic
items.text: Rhythm, melody, voice and instruments as a daily language of expression.

items.name: Financial Literacy
items.text: Early money sense through play: saving, exchange and simple choices.

items.name: PSED
items.text: Personal, Social and Emotional Development: learning to understand feelings, build friendships and grow in confidence.

items.name: Enquiry-Based Learning
items.text: Children ask, explore and reason their way to understanding. The school has a management-confirmed Korean learning partnership; this is not a Korean curriculum or accreditation claim.

items.name: Dance, Music and Theatre
items.text: Stage, studio and story: children find their voice through performance.

senior.title: Seamless Transition to Leading Senior Schools
senior.highlight: Strong Foundations Today. Limitless Opportunities Tomorrow.
paragraphs: At Dolphin Kids School, we believe that a child's educational journey should continue seamlessly beyond the foundational years.

We have established tie-ups and associations with several leading senior schools in Greater Noida and across India to support parents in exploring suitable educational opportunities for their children.
Our network of senior-school associations helps parents understand different educational pathways, admission procedures and curriculum options for the next stage of their child's academic journey.

points.text: Associations with reputed senior schools in Greater Noida and across India.
Guidance and assistance with senior-school admissions.
Exposure to multiple educational boards, including CBSE, ICSE, IB and Cambridge/IGCSE.
Academic preparation for a smooth transition to higher classes.

senior.note: For current associated senior school details, please contact our admissions team. We will gladly walk you through the options for your child.
senior.disclaimer: Admissions are subject to individual school policies and availability.
